prompt:
# Hatchet: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10036/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the short plain brown handle protruding through the top eye, pale steel socket, and disproportionately broad single flared blade with smooth convex edge. Render one complete practical Hatchet on genuine transparent RGBA without ornament. CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): proportions like MM6-MM8 one-handed axes. The handle is long and slender: total height at least 2.4 times the width of the head, with the broad flared blade at the top. Keep the design, only the haft is longer and the head relatively smaller..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the short plain brown handle protruding through the top eye, pale steel socket, and disproportionately broad single flared blade with smooth convex edge. Render one complete practical Hatchet on genuine transparent RGBA without ornament. CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): proportions like MM6-MM8 one-handed axes. The handle is long and slender: total height at least 2.4 times the width of the head, with the broad flared blade at the top. Keep the design, only the haft is longer and the head relatively smaller.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10036/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 is paint_mask_guide.png (edit target, exact geometry and placement authoritative); image 2 is design_reference.png (material appearance); image 3 is icon_x8.png (colour reference only). Preserve guide layout precisely. The reference has plain wood and steel, no decorative carvings. Deliver the painted upper half and flat red/yellow material-mask lower half on true transparent RGBA.
